lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiFe3(OF)4 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a 26-atom unit cell and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors (1.91–2.00 Å) and Li centers coordinated by three F neighbors at 2.06 Å. The Fe octahedra share corners, while Fe and Li polyhedra share faces, and a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spans all 26 sites.
